title: FastaLake paper resources: analysis code, notebooks and source data
description: Analysis code, notebooks and source data for the FastaLake study. Includes updated held-out testing, error controls, functional annotations and validation; the corresponding bioRxiv manuscript revision is pending. Controlled clinical inputs and large external datasets have separate access requirements.
